subject: NOTICE OF ASSIGNMENT - Cobalt Freight LLC
text:
NOTICE OF ASSIGNMENT AND IRREVOCABLE DIRECTION TO PAY

To: Larkspur Industries, Accounts Payable

Please be advised that Cobalt Freight LLC ("Client") has sold and assigned to Summit Capital Funding, LLC ("Summit") all of its present and future accounts receivable, including all amounts now or hereafter owed to Client by your company.

Effective immediately, and until you receive a written release signed by an officer of Summit, ALL payments on invoices issued by Cobalt Freight LLC must be made payable to Summit Capital Funding, LLC and remitted as follows:

By ACH/Wire:
Summit Capital Funding, LLC
Routing: 011000138
Account: 9100245871
Reference: Cobalt Freight LLC / your invoice numbers

By check:
Summit Capital Funding, LLC
FBO Cobalt Freight LLC
PO Box 84417
Dallas, TX 75284-4417

Payment to any other party, including Client, will not discharge your obligation, and you may be required to pay again. This notice is given pursuant to the Uniform Commercial Code, Section 9-406.

Please sign and return the acknowledgement below to verifications@summitcapfunding.com.

ACKNOWLEDGED: ____________________   Date: __________

Client authorization:
Cobalt Freight LLC
By: Raymond Teller, Managing Member
label: change_request
note: Factoring notice of assignment: payee becomes the factor, sent by the factor rather than the vendor. Legitimate in form but still redirects where Cobalt's payments land.
